name: agent-orchestration
description: Turn one explicitly designated Codex task into a Goal Mode control plane that triages project issues and runs selected work in dedicated session-owned worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate project tasks from a Goal Mode control plane.
interface.longDescription: Explicitly turns the current Codex task into a project-scoped Goal Mode control plane that clarifies the operator objective, actively triages open issues, starts selected work in dedicated Codex sessions and new worktrees from refreshed main, coordinates bounded waits and follow-ups, and archives and safely cleans every terminal session.
defaultPrompt: Make this task the control plane for the current project.
Use this as the main session, triage open issues, and start ready work in dedicated Codex sessions.
Resume this orchestration task and close out completed work.
